messages:
maria: Heads-up — saw 3 OOMs hitting dedicated-gpu pool during our long-chat load test.
  stack shows large spikes in KV allocations and a lot of slab fragmentation.

raj: Which test run? can you paste the log snippet / node id?

maria: node: gpu-dedicated-17, run: longchat-100ktokens-2026-03-12. snippet below. looks like repeated small frees then big allocs.

liam: ```
[2026-03-12T14:22:10Z] kv_cache: alloc 1.2GB (session 0x7f8)
[2026-03-12T14:22:10Z] slab: free 128kb, free 4kb, free 256kb ...
[2026-03-12T14:22:11Z] kv_cache: slab_frag_pct=28.4% live_pages=3120
[2026-03-12T14:22:11Z] runtime: OOM while reserving 512MB for KV page
```

sophie: 28% fragmentation is big. does this workload mix quantized and non-quantized model variants? mixed page sizes can blow up reuse patterns.

maria: it's one model but mixed sequence-lengths, lots of many short and few huge turns. that comb causes many partially-filled slabs.

raj: immediate mitigation ideas: 1) enable aggressive compaction (force compact every 1s) 2) put per-session token cap as soft limit (truncate long prefixes) 3) fallback policy to 'truncate+rerun' instead of hard OOM.

liam: we can flip runtime flags via control plane quickly. example curl:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/_runtime/flags -d '{"kv.force_compact":"true","kv.compact_interval_ms":"1000","kv.max_session_tokens":"65536"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
```

maria: do it. also add an emergency fallback: when KV alloc fails, fall back to streaming mode that drops prefix KV (keep recent turns) and continue. less accurate but keeps service up.

deploy-bot: config change applied to pool gpu-dedicated-17 by raj at 2026-03-12T14:30:02Z :white_check_mark:

sophie: +1 to fallback. another longer-term fix is slab coalescing/compaction algorithm — compact adjacent partially-filled slabs when fragmentation crosses threshold. profiling shows 2 hotspots in slab allocator.

raj: I'll open a tiny patch to: 1) add `evict_by_token_count` policy, 2) expose `kv.compact_now` admin endpoint, 3) emit `kv.slab_frag_pct` and `kv.live_pages` per node to metrics. aim to ship as hotfix branch.

liam: for the retry path, suggest we implement a single in-flight retry that switches to `kv.partial=true` then requeue the request. i can sketch the fast-path change.

maria: good. can we also add an alert that triggers at slab_frag_pct > 20% + OOM in 15m? want to catch before it becomes customer impacting.

raj: will add the alert to paging-alerts.

maria: thanks. action items: raj enable flags (done), raj open PR for hotfix, liam sketch retry patch, sophie profile slab hotspots and propose compaction diff. @everyone please add notes to the incident doc. :eyes:

liam: will post perf counters and a minimal repro next.

maria: nice work team. for now the emergency config reduced OOMs to 0 on that pool for the last 2 hours. we'll follow up with the hotfix rollout plan. :shipit:
